title: Further remarks from Araghchi’s press conference with his Russian counterpart
text:
Further remarks from Araghchi’s press conference with his Russian counterpart"

"🔹 European and American countries suffer from miscalculations and mistaken perceptions, and by adopting misguided policies they have become a main cause of wars and international crises."

"🔹 One-sided Western support for the Israeli regime has perpetuated the humanitarian crisis and the mass killing of tens of thousands of people in Gaza, while their continued interventionism has prolonged the war in Ukraine."

"🔹 Likewise, the recent military aggression imposed on the Islamic Republic of Iran—launched on the illusory assumption of weakening the country and with the aim of forcing a surrender within days—has now, after nine months, trapped the aggressor parties in a quagmire with no way out."

"🔹 The current economic and social crises in Western societies are a direct result of these same misguided behaviors, and raising historical claims or distorting the dimensions of the confrontation are merely channels for deceiving world public opinion."
